questions.q: In ASCII, 'A' has the code 65. What is the code for 'H'?
questions.why: H is 7 letters after A, so 65 + 7 = 72.

questions.q: An image is 640 × 480 pixels with a colour depth of 8 bits. What is its file size?
Which shows WWWBBW compressed with run-length encoding?
questions.why: RLE stores each run as a count and a value: three W, two B, one W.

questions.q: State two effects of increasing the colour depth of an image.
questions.model: More colours can be shown so the image is a more accurate/better quality picture, but the file size is larger because more bits are stored for every pixel.
